name: Life is Strange: All Wounds
source:
"Knowing you, day to day, this is love."

Life is Strange: All Wounds is a fan-made sequel story to the original season of Life is Strange, ie the Max/Chloe story arc developed by DontNod. Using one of the game's two endings as a starting point, it is a very personal and exploratory narrative about these two women, having reconnected through such traumatizing events, learning how to lean into each-other to support one another in a relationship, building romance on top of their long-lasting friendship while trying to find ways to cope and heal through everything they've endured. Eventually bringing Stella, Brooke, and Victoria in as supporting characters, All Wounds eventually explores a theoretical future with Max and Chloe confronting and accepting things about their decisions they regret.

[From [url=https://destiny-smasher.itch.io/life-is-strange-all-wounds] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“认识你，日复一日，这就是爱。”

《奇异人生：伤痕累累》是粉丝制作的《奇异人生》第一季的续集故事，即由DontNod开发的麦克斯/克洛伊故事线。以游戏的两个结局之一为起点，这是一个关于这两个女人的非常个人化和探索性的叙述，她们在经历了这些创伤事件后重新建立了联系，学习如何在关系中相互支持，在她们长久的友谊之上建立浪漫，同时试图找到方法来应对和治愈她们所经历的一切。最终，《万伤》以斯特拉、布鲁克和维多利亚作为配角，探索了一个理论上的未来，麦克斯和克洛伊面对并接受了他们后悔的决定。

[来自[url=https://destiny-smasher.itch.io/life-is-strange-all-wounds] itch.io[/url]]
